title: Cleanroom Lab Security Alert at Helios BioTech
description: Environmental sensors detected airlock pressure drops and off-hours door access at the Grade-A cleanroom.

clues.title: Airlock Keycard Swipe In
clues.content: Electronic badge reader at Cleanroom Airlock 1 registered access using badge #402 belonging to Research Fellow Marcus Vance at 02:18 AM.

clues.title: Barometric Decompression Event
clues.content: Cleanroom atmospheric monitor logged differential pressure drop from +45 Pa to +12 Pa between 02:18 AM and 02:22 AM consistent with outer door opening.

clues.title: Corridor Motion Detector (Contradiction)
clues.content: Internal PIR motion detector M-104 directly facing Airlock 1 outer door recorded absolute zero movement between 01:00 AM and 04:00 AM.

clues.title: Cafeteria Log (Irrelevant)
clues.content: Breakroom supply contractor refilled the instant coffee station and paper cups at 16:30 on the preceding afternoon.

clues.title: Vestibule Security Video
clues.content: Security camera C-12 over the outer vestibule captures an individual wearing full Tyvek particulate gown and visor entering Airlock 1 at 02:18 AM.

clues.title: Sensor Failure Diagnostic (Correction)
clues.content: Facilities diagnostic report shows motion detector M-104 suffered a blown 12V DC power fuse at 01:15 AM and was completely offline until technicians replaced it at 07:00 AM.

clues.title: Airlock Keycard Swipe Out
clues.content: Electronic badge reader at Cleanroom Airlock 1 registered exit using badge #402 belonging to Marcus Vance at 02:41 AM.

clues.title: Researcher Phone Call
clues.content: Security desk telephone record documents Marcus Vance calling from Geneva, Switzerland at 08:30 AM stating he is attending the European Biotech Symposium and left his badge inside his desk drawer.

clues.title: Duplicate Airlock Exit Record
clues.content: Electronic badge reader at Cleanroom Airlock 1 registered exit using badge #402 belonging to Marcus Vance at 02:41 AM.

clues.title: Freezer Temperature Log
clues.content: Ultra-low temperature freezer -80C unit #3 in cleanroom was opened for 85 seconds at 02:30 AM before being re-latched.
